Therefore the clause "The agent must eventually reach the goal square." should not be a hard Existence. Make it a soft Existence (or drop it entirely) and keep the hard Existence(has_key) and the hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) as the ordering requirement.

texts: The agent must eventually pick up the key.
The agent may reach the goal square after acquiring the key, but it is not required.
The agent must not reach the goal before having picked up the key.
